response.summary: The Finance Controller agreed that the Pune network switches could be bought from a single supplier.

reasons.statement: Finance Controller agreed that the Pune network switches could be bought from a single supplier.

sources.title: Network switch sourcing
sources.text: From Finance Controller to Priya Nair, Engineering, Wed, 04 Nov 2026 10:00:00 +0530. Yes. No approved Indian supplier carries this switch, so this is a sole-source purchase. Record that reason on the purchase order. Because it is billed in dollars, I will need to approve it myself, and the price must include the currency buffer.
